nodes.label: Rocket Fin Assembly — 3D-Printed Green Fins
nodes.description: Close-up of the aft section of the green 3D-printed rocket showing the fin assembly. Three swept/trapezoidal fins are integrated into the body tube. A wooden dowel (beige/tan) is visible protruding from the aft opening — likely a launch rod guide or motor mount. Surface shows FDM layer lines with some post-processing marks. Rocket laid horizontally on a gray surface.
